subject: PoC: deployment mode & trial plan - Acme Corp
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: PoC: deployment mode & trial plan - Acme Corp

Hi Alice / Tom,

Great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery:

Summary of needs
- Primary goal: integrate LLM-based semantic search + summary assistant into Acme's internal support workflows.
- Top constraints: predictable latency under 300ms p50 for search, strong data isolation, and clear cost model.
- Security: SOC2 + customer-managed KMS is a plus; on-premise is a possible requirement for some teams.

Deployment modes discussed
1) Hosted API (fastest to production, lowest integration effort)
2) Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput and data isolation)
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) - best for strict data residency / compliance

Recommended PoC approach (proposal)
- Primary: 4-week PoC on Dedicated capacity (we can provision a reserved pool) to validate latency/cost under representative load.
- Optional: run a short parallel evaluation of Private deployment for a subset of sensitive data if you want to validate network/ops requirements.

Success criteria (draft)
- <10% error rate on representative queries
- p50 latency < 300ms, p95 < 800ms for target queries
- Cost per 1k queries within budget threshold (TBD by you)
- Integration: working search API + bi-directional logging to your analytics stack

Timeline & stakeholders
- Kickoff: week of Aug 9 (1 hour) - confirm access and test dataset
- Week 1: environment setup (network allowlist, API keys, initial model selection)
- Weeks 2-3: ingestion + traffic replay + tuning
- Week 4: validation, metrics review, decision point (go-live vs Private follow-up)

Requested action from Acme
- Confirm preferred deployment mode to start (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)
- Share preferred kickoff date (we suggested Aug 9-13)
- Share list of internal stakeholders and a point of contact for network/firewall setup

Attachments: acme-poc-success-criteria.docx, acme-network-requirements.pdf

I've cc'd Marissa (solutions) for the technical checklist. Happy to adjust the plan once you confirm the deployment preference.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Liu <tom.liu@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 18:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC: deployment mode & trial plan - Acme Corp

Ben,

Thanks for the thorough recap. We're leaning toward Dedicated capacity for the PoC because predictability and performance are our immediate priorities. Private/VPC is something security will push for long-term, but that adds procurement lead time.

Couple quick Qs:
- Can Dedicated be configured with our KMS (customer-managed keys)?
- Do you have a rough estimate for cost of the 4-week Dedicated PoC so I can flag it with finance?

Stakeholders:
- Tom Liu (engineering lead) - will be primary technical contact
- Priya Natarajan (security) - will evaluate KMS / compliance implications (I'll intro next week if needed)

Preferred kickoff: any time the week of Aug 9, maybe Aug 10 (Tue) morning PT.

Tom, are you good with the proposed SLA targets?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Chen
Director of Product, Acme Corp
alice.chen@acme.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Tom Liu <tom.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Aug 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PoC: deployment mode & trial plan - Acme Corp

Thanks Alice, this is helpful. Short answers up front: yes, Dedicated can be configured to support customer-managed KMS for key wrapping (we'll coordinate with your security team on the exact KMS provider and network flows). I'll put together a ballpark cost for the 4-week PoC and share by EOD Monday.

Updated PoC plan based on your preference (Dedicated primary)
- Scope: 4-week Dedicated PoC covering search + summarization flows using a redacted subset of your support data.
- Resources: 1 dedicated GPU pool (config TBD), access to replay traffic (sanitized), and a shared observability dashboard.
- Success criteria (finalize with you): latency targets, error rate, cost per 1k queries, and integration sanity checks (webhook + analytics ingestion).
- Decision point: end of Week 4 - either move to production on Dedicated or start a gated evaluation of Private (timeline & costs estimated separately).

Proposed kickoff: Tue Aug 10, 10:00 AM PT - 30-45 min to confirm access and run initial smoke tests. Please confirm or propose an alternate time.

I've uploaded an updated success-criteria doc to the drive (link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-poc) and added a HubSpot record for the PoC (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/ACME-2026-042).

Action items
- Ben: send PoC cost estimate by EOD Mon (Aug 2) - DONE: will follow up (I will actually send in a separate email with numbers)
- Alice: confirm kickoff or propose alternate
- Tom: confirm engineering contact and provide replay dataset ETA
- Marissa: coordinate network/jumpbox requirements with Tom

Thanks - looking forward to getting started.

Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Quick technical note from my side before kickoff:
- Network: we'll need an allowlist entry for our provisioning and the dedicated pool IP ranges. I attached a short network requirements PDF (acme-network-requirements.pdf).
- Access: please provide a service account (or temporary token) for replaying queries and a sample of 5k anonymized support transcripts for tuning.
- Telemetry: we'll share a dashboard (Grafana) with latency/cost/error metrics; please confirm which Slack channel we should post alerts to.

I'll be on the kickoff call and will own the week 1 environment setup. If Priya wants to join the kickoff for a 10-15 minute KMS discussion that'd be perfect.
